name: pnsm-frontend-smoke
description: Minimal stand-in for Person 1's and Person 2's Vite apps. It exists so CI can build deploy/frontend.Dockerfile end to end -- proving the multi-stage split works, npm ci succeeds, nginx -t passes and the final image really is under 50 MB -- without this repository depending on either frontend checkout. Zero dependencies on purpose: the point is to measure the base cost of the runtime stage, and any dependency would make the number about that dependency instead.
